scripts.test: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration'
scripts.test:unit: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:runner && node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/unit'
scripts.test:integration: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js playwright test tests/e2e --reporter=line
scripts.test:visual: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/visual
scripts.test:visual:screenshots: npm run patch:test-runtime && ENABLE_SCREENSHOT_VISUALS=1 node scripts/test-queue.js playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.js
scripts.test:perf: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/perf
scripts.test:ci: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual && npm run test:perf'
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:visual && npm run test:perf'
scripts.test:feedback:run: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:runner && node scripts/run-feedback-vitest.js && playwright test tests/e2e/feedback.spec.js --reporter=line'
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js playwright test tests/e2e --reporter=line
scripts.test:audit: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:runner && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e:all'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run patch:test-runtime && VECTURA_TEST_COVERAGE=1 node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run --coverage
scripts.test:update: npm run patch:test-runtime && VECTURA_UPDATE_BASELINES=1 npm run test:visual
scripts.test:vitest: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js
scripts.test:playwright: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/test-queue.js playwright test
scripts.hooks:install: HOOKS_DIR="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks" && cp scripts/hooks/pre-commit "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" && cp scripts/hooks/pre-push "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push" && chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push"
